component_inventory.note: Distinct cited components enumerated from full text.

components.note: Institutional cover plus full six-page report, all11references, all3figures read.
All fetal/neonatal/followup MRI panels inspected alongside captions; no independent radiological diagnosis inferred.
All longitudinal facial photograph panels day1 through5y3m inspected; explicit phenotype text determines polarity.
Index/father/mother IGV tracks and insertion markers inspected; child heterozygous insertion, neither parent shows same markers in displayed region.

limitations: Frozen inputs retained; these are source-transcription/representation flags, not correction of benchmark results.

patient_identity.statement: Single5y4m girl, second child of healthy nonconsanguineous Dutch parents; longitudinalcase and photograph identity consistent.

genotype.statement: Heterozygous de novo NR_003137.2:n.64_65insT; Figure3 gives exact hg38 chr12:120291839 T>TA matching frozen VCF and genomic insertion.
limitations: Packet transcript NR_003137.3 rather than.2; transcript version difference not independently sequence-checked.

segregation.statement: TrioWGS de novo call supported by index-versus-parent IGV tracks.
limitations: Raw genomic data unavailable for independent read-level reproduction; no deep parental mosaicism analysis or explicit paternity verification.

phase.statement: Single heterozygous noncoding insertion; no biallelic phase inference.

causal_confidence.statement: Recurrent RNU4-2 insertion and compatible phenotype after extensive negative investigations support authors likely causal attribution; one newly characterized individual among164clinicaltrios.
limitations: Source calls variant likely pathogenic, whereas frozen packet labels PATHOGENIC; audit does not upgrade source confidence.
Patient fibroblast RNA-seq reanalysis showed no large-scale intron retention (data notshown); mechanism not functionally established in this case.
Onecase/164 is ascertainment-dependent yield, not an estimate of universal diagnosis accuracy; publication follows discovery preprint.

phenotype_completeness.statement: All56mappedfeaturestatuses compared; four explicit positive source facial findings frozen as excluded, plus numerous unsupported additions/negatives.
